_docs.grid: [i, j] on the ceiling coffer grid — i across X (0 = centre line), j rows upstage→downstage from coffer.zOffset. pos [x,y,z] overrides grid.
_docs.angles: pan: degrees about Y, 0 = facing upstage (−Z), +ve toward ladies side (+X). tilt: degrees from straight down, 0 = straight down, tipping toward the pan direction.
_docs.beam: full cone angle, degrees. intensity 0–1 (visual only — no photometry, per SPEC §6).
